organizations.name: ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)
organizations.focus_area: Launch Vehicles, Earth Observation, Navigation, Deep Space
organizations.description: National space agency of India operating under the Department of Space, responsible for end-to-end orbital launch systems, interplanetary exploration, and national satellite infrastructure.

organizations.name: NewSpace India Limited (NSIL)
organizations.description: Central Public Sector Enterprise under Department of Space serving as the commercial arm of ISRO for PSLV, SSLV, and LVM3 rideshare and dedicated missions.

organizations.name: Skyroot Aerospace
organizations.description: India's first private orbital-class rocket company, developer of the Vikram series of carbon-composite solid and cryogenic launch vehicles (Vikram-S, Vikram-1).

organizations.name: Agnikul Cosmos
organizations.description: IIT Madras-incubated launch startup operating India's first private launchpad (ALP-01) at SDSC Sriharikota and single-piece 3D-printed Agnilet semi-cryogenic engines.

organizations.name: Pixxel Space
organizations.description: Builder of the Firefly commercial hyperspectral Earth observation constellation providing 5m-resolution 150+ band spectral imaging for climate, agriculture, and mining.

organizations.name: Bellatrix Aerospace
organizations.description: In-space propulsion specialist developing Rudra green monopropellant thrusters, Arka Hall-effect thrusters, and the Pushpak Orbital Transfer Vehicle (OTV).

organizations.name: Dhruva Space
organizations.description: Full-stack space engineering company building P-DoT modular nanosatellite buses, space-grade solar arrays, deployers (DSOD), and Ground-Station-as-a-Service.

organizations.name: Digantara
organizations.description: Space Situational Awareness (SSA) and orbital traffic management startup deploying SCOT space-based optical and LIDAR debris-tracking sensors.

organizations.name: GalaxEye Space
organizations.description: Multi-sensor Earth observation company pioneering Drishti SyncFused Opto-SAR payloads combining Synthetic Aperture Radar and multispectral optical imaging.

launch_vehicles.name: LVM3 (GSLV Mk III)
launch_vehicles.propulsion_type: Solid S200 + Liquid L110 + Cryogenic C25

launch_vehicles.name: GSLV Mk II
launch_vehicles.propulsion_type: Solid S139 + Liquid GS2 + Indigenous Cryogenic CUS

launch_vehicles.name: PSLV-XL
launch_vehicles.propulsion_type: Solid + Liquid Vikas + Solid + Liquid PS4

launch_vehicles.name: SSLV
launch_vehicles.propulsion_type: 3 Solid Stages + Liquid Velocity Trimming Module

launch_vehicles.name: Vikram-1
launch_vehicles.propulsion_type: Carbon-Composite Solid + Hypergolic Raman Orbital Stage

missions.title: Gaganyaan-G1 Uncrewed Orbital Flight
missions.remarks: First uncrewed orbital qualification flight of Human-Rated LVM3 carrying the Vyommitra humanoid robot, Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS), and Crew Escape System validation.

missions.title: GSLV-F18 / NVS-03 (IRNSS-1K)
missions.remarks: Third second-generation NavIC satellite featuring indigenous Rubidium Atomic Frequency Standard (RAFS) and L1 civilian navigation band.

missions.title: Vikram-1 Maiden Commercial Orbital Launch
missions.remarks: First private Indian orbital launch vehicle flight from SDSC Sriharikota powered by Kalam-1200 carbon-composite first stage.

missions.title: LVM3-M6 / BlueBird Block-2 Commercial Mission
missions.remarks: Dedicated commercial heavy-lift launch contracted through NSIL deploying next-generation direct-to-device broadband communications satellite.

missions.title: Chandrayaan-4 Lunar Sample Return Architecture
missions.remarks: Multi-module lunar sample return mission using dual LVM3 launches for Ascender/Descender and Transfer/Re-entry stacks with orbital docking.

missions.title: Agnibaan Orbital Demonstrator
missions.remarks: Follow-on orbital flight from Agnikul Private Launchpad (ALP-01) powered by clustered 3D-printed Agnilet semi-cryogenic engines.

missions.title: PSLV-C62 / EOS-N1 (Anvesha) & Rideshare
missions.remarks: Primary hyperspectral imaging satellite EOS-N1 deployed alongside Pixxel Firefly commercial constellation satellites and student CubeSats.

missions.title: GSLV-F17 / EOS-05 (GISAT-1A)
missions.remarks: Agile geostationary Earth observation satellite delivering near-real-time disaster monitoring and multispectral imaging over the Indian subcontinent.

missions.title: PSLV-C60 / SpaDeX Space Docking Experiment
missions.remarks: Historic autonomous orbital rendezvous and docking demonstration by SDX01 (Chaser) and SDX02 (Target), making India the 4th nation to master space docking.

missions.title: SSLV-D3 / EOS-08 & SR-0 DEMOSAT
missions.remarks: Third developmental flight completing SSLV operational qualification and deploying EOS-08 microsatellite.

missions.title: Aditya-L1 Solar Corona Observatory
missions.remarks: India's first space-based solar observatory stationed 1.5 million km from Earth at Lagrange Point 1 carrying 7 scientific payloads including VELC and SUIT.

missions.title: Chandrayaan-3 Lunar South Pole Lander
missions.remarks: First spacecraft to achieve a controlled soft landing near the Lunar South Pole (Shiv Shakti Point) with Vikram Lander and Pragyan Rover.

payloads.name: Gaganyaan Orbital Module + Vyommitra
payloads.purpose: Uncrewed human-rated crew & service module qualification with humanoid telemetry rig

payloads.name: NVS-03 Navigation Satellite
payloads.purpose: NavIC regional PNT augmentation with indigenous atomic clock

payloads.name: Digantara SCOT-2 SSA Payload
payloads.purpose: Space-based orbital debris tracking & Space Situational Awareness

payloads.name: Chandrayaan-4 Ascender & Descender Stack
payloads.purpose: Lunar regolith drilling, scooping, and ascent sample transfer

payloads.name: GalaxEye Drishti Opto-SAR Demo
payloads.purpose: All-weather fused Synthetic Aperture Radar and optical imaging

payloads.name: Bellatrix Pushpak OTV / Rudra Thruster
payloads.purpose: In-space orbital transfer and green propulsion demonstration

payloads.name: EOS-N1 (Anvesha) Hyperspectral Sat
payloads.purpose: Coastal, forestry, and strategic spectral surveillance

payloads.name: Dhruva Space LEAP-1 Hosted Payload
payloads.purpose: P-30 satellite bus qualification and Australian IoT payload

payloads.name: SDX01 Chaser & SDX02 Target
payloads.purpose: Autonomous orbital rendezvous, docking, and power transfer

payloads.name: EOS-08 Microsatellite
payloads.purpose: EOIR, GNSS-R, and SiC UV dosimeter technology demonstrator

payloads.name: Aditya-L1 Observatory (VELC + SUIT + 5 Instruments)
payloads.purpose: Continuous solar corona, chromosphere, and solar wind spectrometry

payloads.name: Vikram Lander & Pragyan Rover
payloads.purpose: Lunar South Pole surface thermophysical & elemental spectroscopy

isro_centres.name: Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre
isro_centres.primary_role: Lead centre for launch vehicle design & propulsion (PSLV, GSLV, LVM3, SSLV, Gaganyaan Crew Escape)

isro_centres.name: U R Rao Satellite Centre
isro_centres.primary_role: Primary hub for designing, building, and integrating Indian spacecraft, lunar landers, and planetary probes

isro_centres.name: Satish Dhawan Space Centre
isro_centres.primary_role: India's primary spaceport operating FLP, SLP, solid propellant casting, and private launchpad ALP-01

isro_centres.name: Space Applications Centre
isro_centres.primary_role: Design and development of space-borne optical, SAR, and microwave communication & EO payloads

isro_centres.name: ISRO Telemetry, Tracking and Command Network
isro_centres.primary_role: 24/7 Mission Operations Complex (MOX), Deep Space Network (IDSN Byalalu), and global ground stations

isro_centres.name: Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre
isro_centres.primary_role: Research and development of Vikas liquid engines, CE-20 cryogenic engines, and semi-cryogenic stages

isro_centres.name: ISRO Propulsion Complex
isro_centres.primary_role: Hot-firing test stands for cryogenic CE-20, Vikas, and Gaganyaan Service Module propulsion systems

isro_centres.name: National Remote Sensing Centre
isro_centres.primary_role: Satellite Earth observation data reception (Shadnagar), Bhuvan geospatial portal, and disaster support

isro_centres.name: Physical Research Laboratory
isro_centres.primary_role: Space & planetary sciences, Aditya-L1 and Chandrayaan scientific payload instrumentation
